content: Karan Joshi sent a renewal quote for home policy HP-2024-5678 (expiring 15 Oct 2026) with two options: keeping the sum insured at ₹25,00,000 or increasing it to ₹30,00,000 for an extra ₹1,200/year. Diya Menon expressed concern about the tight timeline due to upcoming November renovations, asking about grace period extensions and clarification on the premium difference for the higher sum insured.

action_items: Clarify premium difference for the higher sum insured option
Advise on grace period extension or immediate renewal
Confirm preferred renewal option by 08 October 2026
